name: Cleat Harbor
tagline: Run your marina without the clipboard, the whiteboard, or the shouting.
positioning: Cleat Harbor is the operations software for small marinas — slips, waitlists, fuel dock, and seasonal contracts in one place your dockhands won't hate.

hero.h1: Your marina is not a spreadsheet with a view.
hero.sub: Cleat Harbor replaces the dockage binder, the sticky-note waitlist, and the group text nobody reads. Assign slips, bill seasonals, and run the fuel dock from one screen.

features.title: Slip assignments that make sense
features.description: Drag boats onto a live map of your basin. Beam, draft, and length flags catch the 42-footer someone tried to squeeze into a 30-foot slip.

features.title: Waitlists people actually trust
features.description: Rank transients and seasonal hopefuls by date, size, and priority. When a slip opens, Cleat Harbor texts the next in line so you don't have to.

features.title: Dockage billing on autopilot
features.description: Prorate seasonal contracts, meter electric, and bill transients by the night. Late fees apply themselves so you can stop being the bad guy.

features.title: Fuel dock and pump-outs
features.description: Log gallons, print receipts, and reconcile the fuel dock till at close — instead of doing math on the back of a launch ticket.

features.title: Storms don't wait for you
features.description: Pull a hurricane haul-out list in one click: every boat, owner, and phone number, sorted by who needs to move first.

features.title: Works on the dock, not just the desk
features.description: Dockhands check in arrivals from a phone with salt-water hands. No login gymnastics, no laptop by the gas pump.

testimonials.quote: We ran 180 slips out of a three-ring binder and a whiteboard held together with tape. Cleat Harbor found four boats we'd been storing for free since 2021. It paid for itself by Memorial Day.
testimonials.name: DanaРечь

testimonials.quote: The transient waitlist used to be whoever yelled loudest on the VHF. Now it's a list, and I can point to it. My blood pressure sends its thanks.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Our seasonal invoices went out on April 1 for the first time in the marina's history. My accountant asked if we hired someone. We didn't. We got software.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

homepage.footerBlurb: Cleat Harbor is marina operations software for owner-operators who'd rather be on the water than in a spreadsheet. Built by people who've untangled dock lines.
